Human.abilities: One extra Edge at creation (ignore requirements except prerequisites)
Human.notes: Most common species in the galaxy; adaptable and versatile

Twi'lek.abilities: +1 Persuasion, Low-light vision, Performance d6 (lekku dance and traditional Ryloth arts); -1 Quirk: Lekku make some armor and helmets awkward
Twi'lek.notes: From Ryloth; lekku (head-tails) express emotion; often targeted by slavers

Wookiee.abilities: d6 Strength, +1 Size; Cannot speak Basic (Minor), -2 Persuasion with strangers
Wookiee.notes: From Kashyyyk; fierce warriors; life-debt tradition; Shyriiwook only

Trandoshan.abilities: Athletics d6 (climbing specialist), +2 to natural Vigor healing rolls, Claws (Str+d6); Cold-blooded (-4 resist cold), -2 Persuasion
Trandoshan.notes: Reptilian hunters from Trandosha; bounty hunter culture

Bothan.abilities: +2 Notice, Low-light vision, Stealth d6 (spynet field tradecraft); Curious—can't resist seeking intel (Minor)
Bothan.notes: Famous spy network; "Many Bothans died" for Death Star plans

Duros.abilities: Piloting d6, Astrogation d6, Low-light vision; Slender build (Pace 5)
Duros.notes: From Duro; spacefaring pioneers; large red eyes, hairless blue skin

Rodian.abilities: +2 Notice (sight), Infravision, Shooting d6 (hunters and duelists); -2 Persuasion (insectoid appearance unsettles many)
Rodian.notes: From Rodia; hunting culture; compound eyes, antennae

Zabrak.abilities: +2 Spirit to recover from Shaken, +1 Toughness; Stubborn (Minor)
Zabrak.notes: From Iridonia; distinctive facial horns and tattoos; sheer will keeps them in the fight

Chiss.abilities: d6 Smarts, Low-light vision; -2 Persuasion (cold, aloof demeanor), Cautious—methodical and calculating, hesitates in uncertain situations (Minor)
Chiss.notes: From Csilla; expansionist; blue skin, glowing red eyes

Droid.abilities: Construct (ignore wound modifiers, disease, poison), Immune to poison/disease, Integrated systems (diagnostics, tool mounts), Repair d6 (maintenance protocols); Vulnerable to ion/EMP (-4 resist electricity), -2 Persuasion with organics, Maintenance (must recharge 8hrs per day or gain Fatigue)
Droid.notes: Artificial beings; programmable; requires 8hrs daily recharge or suffers Fatigue like organics without sleep

Togruta.abilities: +1 Notice (spatial awareness via montrals — distance and movement only), +2 Stealth in natural or outdoor environments (camouflage patterning), Low-light vision; Pack mentality—strongly Loyal to their group (Minor)
Togruta.notes: From Shili; Ahsoka Tano's species; striped camouflage evolved for turu-grass hunting; pack hunters

Nautolan.abilities: Empathic tendrils (+2 Notice to detect lies, hostility, or hidden emotions), Low-light vision, Amphibious (breathe underwater); Outsider (–2 Persuasion outside Glee Anselm culture, Minor)
Nautolan.notes: From Glee Anselm; head tendrils sense pheromones and emotional states; Kit Fisto's species

Kel Dor.abilities: Darkvision, +4 resist vacuum/low pressure, Common Knowledge d6, Low-light vision, Piloting d6 (void and thin-atmosphere operations); Oxygen toxicity—must wear breath mask off Dorin (Major)
Kel Dor.notes: From Dorin; Plo Koon's species; antiox mask and goggles required off-world

Lasat.abilities: d6 Strength, +1 Size; Code of Honor (Minor), -2 Persuasion (outsider)
Lasat.notes: From Lasan; Zeb's species; large, strong, honor-bound warriors

Mon Calamari.abilities: Repair d6 (shipwright instincts), +1 to Battle rolls (tactical acumen), Low-light vision, Amphibious (breathe underwater); Cautious—methodical, rarely acts without a plan (Minor)
Mon Calamari.notes: From Mon Cala; Admiral Ackbar's species; master shipwrights and fleet tacticians

Sullustan.abilities: Piloting d6, Low-light vision, +2 Notice in darkness (echolocation); Pace 5
Sullustan.notes: From Sullust; Nien Nunb's species; natural pilots; cave dwellers with large ears

Devaronian.notes: From Devaron; horned humanoids; merchants and smugglers

Shistavanen.abilities: Darkvision (ignore all darkness penalties), +2 to Survival and Notice when tracking or hunting, Pace 8 with d8 running die (digitigrade legs); Outsider—unsettling to most species (Minor)
Shistavanen.notes: From Uvena Prime; wolf-like hunters; exceptional trackers; bounty hunters and scouts
